// serverUrl: Base URL the TVs use to reach this Mac. Leave empty to auto-detect your LAN IP (recommended). Example: http://192.168.1.50:8409
// mediaDir: Absolute path to the folder of media you want to stream from this Mac mini.
// liveCountries: Optional. Only keep live channels whose group-title matches one of these (case-insensitive). Empty = keep all.
// directPlayExtensions: Files with these extensions are streamed as-is (seekable). Everything else is transcoded on the fly when transcode=true.
// loopChannels: Optional always-on channels. Each loops the videos in a folder forever, like a real TV station. path is relative to mediaDir (or absolute).
